name: Composer Shell
description: Three-column workspace shell of the Composer context-engine app: composition-stack rail (left), active layer canvas (center), files rail (right). Modeled from XAML + code-behind + the MVUX ShellModel. The eight per-layer canvases hosted by the center ContentControl are out of scope; the canvas slot that hosts them is modeled.

properties.mechanism: Click="OnLayerRowClick" → MvuxCommandInvoker.Invoke(page.DataContext, "Jump", index) → ActiveIndex → SyncSlot swaps the hosted canvas
Revisit link → ShellModel.Revisit sets ActiveIndex to that layer and its state back to Clean
Chip click writes the prompt; a non-empty prompt marks the active layer Dirty
TextChanged → SetActivePrompt → MarkDirty when the text is non-empty
GeneratePreview stages the proposal and sets the layer state to Previewing
Locking a layer makes LockedLayers non-empty and advances ActiveIndex, so RailsVisible becomes true

evidence.rationale: RailsVisible is declared as LockedLayers.Count > 0 || ActiveIndex > 0; both commands set a layer Locked and call AdvanceIfPossible.

properties.mechanism: Restores the snapshot, clears the prompt and sets the layer state to Clean
Restores the pre-preview snapshot and sets the layer state to Clean; also bound to Escape in the textarea
Reset returns every layer to Clean and ActiveIndex to 0, so RailsVisible becomes false

evidence.rationale: Reset sets all LayerStates Clean and ActiveIndex 0; RailsVisible is declared from exactly those two values. The button is currently collapsed in the shipped layout.

unresolved.question: Should the center column become a navigation region (uen:Region.Attached) hosting per-layer Pages, or stay a direct ContentControl host?
possibleValues: region-based navigation with the registered RouteMap
unresolved.reason: Shell.xaml and ActiveCanvas.xaml.cs both comment that the region-based host did not mount pages and was reverted, while Pages + RouteMap remain registered as scaffolding. The graph models only the implemented direct hosting.

unresolved.question: Is AppTitleRow (project name + Reset link) part of the intended shell surface, or dead markup?
unresolved.reason: It is instantiated with Visibility="Collapsed" and a comment saying the title moved inside the glass container, yet its ProjectName/ShowReset bindings are still wired and Reset is the only path to the Reset command on this surface.

unresolved.question: Should ActiveLayerHeader own the layer label, title and subtitle, or do those belong permanently to each layer canvas?
unresolved.reason: LayerLabelText, TitleText and SubtitleText exist and are assigned from code-behind but are Collapsed with a comment that they render inside the layer canvas instead. Only the recap row and state badge are visible today.

unresolved.question: Is the README.md row duplicated in the files rail intentional?
unresolved.reason: The Intent layer's declared File is README.md and FilesRail.Render appends Layers.ReadmeFileName again as a synthesized companion, producing ten rows with README.md twice, while the summary counts eight layers. The class comment says nine files.

unresolved.question: Is the locked card's expand/collapse toggle meant to persist?
unresolved.reason: IsExpanded is documented as two-way against DefaultExpandedKinds, but ActiveCanvas.SyncLockedStack clears and rebuilds the cards on every relevant model change, so a manual toggle is discarded. No binding back to the model exists.

unresolved.question: Are the composition-stack layer row and the files-rail file row one shared rail-row component?
possibleValues: one canonical rail row with two variants
unresolved.reason: Both are three-column rows in a 280 px rail with a leading state marker, mono text and a trailing badge, and both are projected from a per-row record. Their semantics differ (navigation target vs artifact status) and only one is interactive, so they are modeled separately.

unresolved.question: Should the shared motion values (480 ms / 320 ms / 240 ms durations, QuinticEase EaseOut) be tokens?
unresolved.reason: The same 480 ms QuinticEase EaseOut recurs across the rail reveal, canvas resize, progress fill and future-card entrance, and Tokens.xaml declares Duration.* / Ease* keys — but this surface hardcodes the values instead of referencing those keys, and the v0.1 token categories have no motion category. Recorded as state properties instead.

metadata.scope: Composer shell surface only. The eight per-layer canvases under Views/Layers/ are out of scope; the canvas slot that hosts them is modeled as a content region.
metadata.tokenScope: Only values this surface consumes directly or through a style it uses. Theme dictionaries were not enumerated: phase tints, state tints, error colors, the Space*/Spacing*/Corner* scales, the Duration/Ease keys and the wider type-style catalog are declared in Themes/ but unreferenced here.
